boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 98 divides the board into partitioned zones with orange frame borders. Cyan `5` blocks fill the upper-left section, a purple `8` chamber sits in the center behind lock/key gates, and a purple `13` chamber fills the lower section. Narrow channels connect the zones — blocks must route single-file through them. Drain the cyan section first, unlock and feed the `8` chamber, then finish with the `13` chamber for 26 total passes.
landmarks: Block Out Level 98 divides the board into partitioned zones with orange frame borders.
Cyan `5` blocks fill the upper-left section, a purple `8` chamber sits in the center behind lock/key gates, and a purple `13` chamber fills the lower section.
Narrow channels connect the zones — blocks must route single-file through them.
Drain the cyan section first, unlock and feed the `8` chamber, then finish with the `13` chamber for 26 total passes.

quickTips: Drain the cyan `5` section first — it is the fastest feed and opens room for everything else.
Clear all small blocks from channels before starting any chamber feed — one stray piece halts everything.
Sort spilled blocks immediately after the `8` chamber collapses, before starting the `13` feed.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Drain the cyan `5` blocks in the upper-left through the left-wall exit — five passes (02:52 in the video).

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the large red block below the cyan section through the right-wall exit to open the channel to the center zone (02:46).

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Unlock the key blocks to access the purple `8` chamber's zone because the lock gates block the only channel in (02:39).

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear small green and blue blocks from the channels between zones before they drift during the feed (02:33).

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Feed the purple `8` chamber through the channel — eight passes, keeping the narrow passage clear (02:26–02:13).

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Sort the spilled blocks from the `8` chamber collapse before they enter the lower zone and block the `13` lane (02:13).

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Clear the small red and cyan blocks around the `13` chamber through nearby exits (02:07).

steps.title: Move 8
steps.instruction: Feed the purple `13` chamber through the bottom exits — thirteen passes to finish (02:01–01:41).

failurePoints: Starting the `8` chamber feed while small blocks are still in the channels — they block the single-file passage and halt the feed with no way to clear them without resetting.
Ignoring the spilled blocks after the `8` chamber collapses — they enter the lower zone and jam the `13` chamber's exit lane, forcing multiple recovery moves.
